purpose: Names of secrets for Cloudflare Workers deploy + Codex. Values never in git.

github_actions_secrets.name: MCP_API_TOKEN
github_actions_secrets.where: Render env group never86-grok-bot-stack (generateValue) or scripts/generate-secrets.mjs

github_actions_secrets.name: NEVER86_API_URL
github_actions_secrets.where: Render web service URL after Blueprint deploy

github_actions_secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
github_actions_secrets.where: Cloudflare Dashboard → My Profile → API Tokens (create new; do not reuse a token that appeared in a screenshot/chat)
used_by: Optional Cloudflare Workers/Pages deploys from GitHub Actions

github_actions_secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
github_actions_secrets.note: Also recorded under stack/wiring.json cloudflare.account_id when known

github_actions_secrets.name: PORTAL_SESSION_SECRET
github_actions_secrets.where: Generate with openssl rand -base64 48; GitHub Actions / Codex / host env only — never git
github_actions_secrets.note: ≥32 chars. Pair with PORTAL_COOKIE_SECURE=1 and PORTAL_HSTS=1 behind TLS.
